label: Heist
description: Plan the impossible job, pull it off, survive the double-cross.

beats.label: The Score
beats.directive: Introduce the protagonist, the prize worth stealing, why they need it, and who guards it.

beats.label: Assembling the Crew
beats.directive: Recruit a specialist or gather intel on the target; plant a tool or weakness that will matter later.

beats.label: Going In
beats.directive: The job begins and an unexpected obstacle forces improvisation. Earlier shortcuts now cost the crew.
fallbackChoices: Stick to the plan and wait

beats.label: Double-Cross
beats.directive: Someone's loyalty breaks or a hidden agenda surfaces; the prize or the crew is now at risk.
fallbackChoices: Play along and turn the trap

beats.label: The Getaway
beats.directive: Everything converges: the prize, the guard, the traitor. Choices are final, decisive moves.
fallbackChoices: Sacrifice the prize to save the crew

beats.label: The Split
beats.directive: Show who walks away with what and what it cost; the outcome reflects the path taken. Offer no choices.
